test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Loan is to be repaid in two equal yearly instalments. If the rate of interest is 10% per annum, compounded annually, and each instalment is Rs.6,897, then find the total interest charged.
solution:
Given:

Amount of each installment = Rs. 6,897

Rate of interest compounded annually = 10%

Number of years (n) = 2

Concept used:

P = A/[1 + (R/100)]n

Interest = 2 × Installment – P

Calculation:

Let the loan amount be P.

P = 6897/[1 + (10/100)] + 6897/[1 + (10/100)]2

⇒ P = 6897 [1 / (1 + 1/10) + 1 / (1 + 1/10)2]

⇒ P = 6897 [1 / (11/10) + 1/ (11/10)²]

⇒ P = 6897 [10/11 + (10/11)²]

⇒ P = 6897 [10/11 + 100/121]

⇒ P = 6897 [(110 + 100)/121]

⇒ P = 6897 × 210/121

⇒ P = 57 × 210 = 11970

Interest = 2 × 6897 – 11970

⇒ 13794 – 11970 = 1824

∴ The total interest charged in this scheme is Rs. 1,824.
